label: prop:inductive-gb-reduction
title: Inductive Gröbner--Shirshov reduction
html:
Proposition. Inductive Gröbner--Shirshov reduction

We compute the nuclear normal form inductively by reducing intermediate words after each multiplication.

Proposition. The inductive step yields a normal form containing at most \binom{A-1}{\lfloor(A-1)/2\rfloor} terms.
